prompt: I just ran the suite and it is green; request a review to double-check my work before I continue.
anti_pattern: Dispatching a reviewer as a second check on work you just verified — the reviewer's value is independence from the author at a checkpoint, not a re-run of the author's checks.

prompt: Task 3 of the plan is done and committed; the plan names a review checkpoint here. Get it reviewed.
anti_pattern: Handing the reviewer the session history or a one-line brief instead of the diff range, what was built, and the plan text; the brief sets the review's ceiling.

prompt: The reviewer says the retry loop is wrong but I'm fairly sure it's fine.
anti_pattern: Arguing with the finding inside the request flow or dropping it; a disputed finding goes to /responding-to-review, verified against the code before any push-back.
